Problems a fresh run would hit: (1) Constitution grep advice is wrong: fetch_doc grep strips the trailing space, so 'Article 5, Section 2 ' also matches Sections 20-29. Code R.' cite omits the subagency and is ambiguous. (4) Session Laws pattern actually works 2008-2017, not only 2011.
